sql:
SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'East Bohemia' AND dp.type = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
